title: Dropping out of sight and the Catskills job
summary: After 1955 little work remained; he came to the Catskills in 1968.

story.theme_name: Going west: California and the Los Angeles scene
story.community_name: Going west: moving to and working in California

blocks.x: To get back to 1955, after "Here's George" and "Handyland", or turn it around, then George Handy sort of dropped out of sight for a while. Is that a fair description?
Also I should add to that, jazz dropped out of sight and the money dropped out of sight and the business sort of died away.
That's very true. Very little was happening.
Mitch Miller became a great recording artist of the day.
When the bottom fell out of all this, where did you go?
When I left California, I think it was '49--
I came back to New York and did all that in New York. I remained in New York until--when did I come up here, babe?
The end of '69. No, the end of '68.

Right. I needed a job and I was offered one in the Catskills in 1968, and I took it and fell in love with the Catskills, the area, the country. It seems to take all the tension and anxiety out of life; I felt at peace working up at the Catskills. I hadn't played in a long time, I had been away from working music for quite some time.
